Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> mr;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined mr (media clock
restart) 1 bit header field.
The value range for version shall be:
0x00...0x01 : valid
0x02...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set value of mr to 0, if it is not provided by the application.

protected
